title: Volume of a thin slab inside a closed ball of ℝᵐ
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, e, c ∈ ℝᵐ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) with ‖e‖ = 1, and ε, R ∈ ℝ with ε ≥ 0 and R ≥ 0. Then the set S := {v ∈ ℝᵐ : ‖v − c‖ ≤ R and |⟨e, v − c⟩| ≤ ε} satisfies Lᵐ(S) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(2ε·(2R)^{m−1}), where m − 1 is truncated natural-number subtraction and Lᵐ = volume.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (e c : Rn m) (ε R : ℝ), ‖e‖ = 1 → 0 ≤ ε → 0 ≤ R → volume {v : Rn m | ‖v - c‖ ≤ R ∧ |inner ℝ e (v - c)| ≤ ε} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ε * (2 * R) ^ (m - 1))
